items.item: F1 persistence is not yet an order ([^ethics], [^own], [^axiom])
items.how: 'A life that goes on holds its own continuation: what does not hold it ceases' is gone from the notes. [^ethics]: 'A life goes on through what sustains it, and what is not sustained ceases; that says that it keeps going, not yet that it ranks courses: a stone goes on and ranks nothing, a system kept by its environment ranks nothing, and an agent can be indifferent between two courses. Where a life holds its own continuation as an order over courses ... (self-concern, Weighting.IncreasingInOwn), that order is, in the proofs, a hypothesis ...; that a life forms such an order is argued, not shown.' [^own] reads 'its own continuation matters' three ways (keeping; significance held de se, P1; an order over courses) and says the first does not give the other two; lead 'Argued, not shown; in the proofs, hypotheses.' [^axiom] no longer says 'holding one's own continuation needs no step': it says the self's presupposition, held de se along being affected, is the condition with no step. The other session's Lean is not cited or anticipated.

[^axiom]: 'On the reading of significance as what lies within a center's closure along a relation, held de se (a reading: no law picks the relation or the centers, 07 §1)'; [^ethics]: 'on the reading of significance as what lies within each center's closure along a relation'; [^guardian] keeps 'the continuation condition, read on relations'. No note equates the condition with 续无外 or closure without the reading.

Checked in the Lean: Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted (MutualDependence.lean:138) gives Unrestricted (bounded fun q => L.WithinInfluence W (center q)); bounded, WithinInfluence (WithinClosure (AffectedBy)), selfAscribed and ownClosure unfold so that this is selfAscribed (ownClosure AffectedBy) center; Web.DependsOn and Flow.Exchanges are each 'at some step'. [^axiom] now says mutual dependence gives the condition read as what lies within each center's influence closure (Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted), the presupposition held de se along being affected being the condition with no step (ownClosure_unrestricted_of_whole); 'the two are not yet joined into one theorem' is gone. [^ethics]: 'Mutual dependence gives the condition read along being affected (the note on the step); the route from it to the ranking on a web is not stated as one theorem.' Time: [^axiom] 'Being affected is read without time: one formation affects another where, at some step, it exchanges with a condition the other depends on at some step', with «续无外则同一中心» beside it ('so "where relations close" is said of formations, read without time'); [^guardian] 'among actual formations'; [^present] 'affecting read without time'. Flow.returning_unrestricted_iff_mutuallyDependent not cited.

'on listed courses' gone from the notes. [^ethics]: on a finite listing, if every listed item is one's own, an order favouring additions to one's own favours every widening (Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_iff_unrestricted); on a web, between two level paths whose admitted step-formation pairs fit in one finite list (Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn), such paths admitting nothing from some step on (Web.admits_nothing_from_of_listed), 'so the ranking is shown for courses that end, and for courses that go on forming without end it is not shown'; 'the order ranks every widening above, and may rank other pairs too, so it is not shown to be widening itself, nor the only such order'. [^axiom] states the ranking 'on a finite listing and between two courses whose admissions fit in a finite list'.

items.item: F5 no authority outside becoming, at its reach
items.how: [^ethics]'s '*No warrant to find.* No should stands beyond becoming, so there is no warrant binding every mind to find, and the ethics does not wait on one' became '*No authority outside becoming.* The ethics seeks no authority outside becoming and offers itself without one: argued, on the thesis of one relational unfolding (08)'; the non-entailment proved (ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails; bounded_rival); 'Whether a reason formed within becoming could hold for every mind the work does not claim or settle; how scope and order form within becoming is its open target (07 #r-universal-practical-warrant, 08 §12)'. The record and its status are the ch07 agent's.

items.item: F6 seeing needed, and not enough
items.how: [^ethics]'s 'A center whose seeing stops at its own closure ranks more narrowly: a matter of reach ...' is gone; now '*Seeing.* Coupling limits what a selection can respond to; reading a loss, counting it and ranking courses are separate relations, so seeing more is needed, and not enough (07 #does-not-show). Where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation does not reach those who depend on one; seeing them is needed there, and counting their loss is the one step the body offers: the step of invariance, argued, and deniable without contradiction.' [^axiom] says the same at its place ('there the step, like T8's way of seeing, reaches further, as seeing, not as a warrant' gone).
No change needed: the opening's notes do not quote or interpret 08 §8's 'a clarified ethics, not a grounded one' (grep); the USES parenthesis is the uses agent's file.

items.item: F8 T8's test at its reach
items.how: [^ethics] after T8's line: 'That test asks whether reading what a course draws on and what ends with it lowers overshoot of a renewal the readers themselves depend on; it does not test the offer toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.'

items.item: F9 widening and C said once and plainly
items.how: [^ethics] '*Widening.*': one course widens another when it keeps all the other keeps and lets more form, more future, a pattern within becoming, not good and evil; on a finite listing exactly what every additive weighting positive on every listed item ranks higher (Weighting.widens_iff_every_positive), 'what every way of counting each thing as worth something agrees on, and no second premise'; 'An order ranking a course above every course it widens is named C (Comparison) ... and a result that takes it says so'; the body's 'second reading' read as no second premise and its 'better' as more future; C's time as a second premise (about 10 October to 9 November 2026) kept as where the map was wrong, linked to 07's before-copy §4 'Scope and order: two premises, two roles'. Gone: 'Beyond it ... C is a named order', '"Better" is the word C's theorems use'. [^alignment]: '(scope)' and '(order)' labels off the direction's hypotheses, C stated as Comparison. [^good-evil]: 'a result that ranks the wider course above states the order it takes, self-concern or C'. Mixed courses: 'the laws show it mixed and weigh it for no one' in [^ethics] and [^good-evil].

items.item: E1, E8, E10, D6, D7 kept
items.how: [^good-evil]'s dated lead and Ren's quoted words unchanged; every ranking claim states its theorem's hypotheses (admission decided, listing, every claim counted as living, one way); no 'standing'/地位 label in the notes (the two hits are the verb); what is not claimed is said where a reader would believe it (T8's test, courses without end, the order not unique).

[^axiom], [^ethics] (whole note), [^good-evil], [^alignment], [^guardian], [^own], [^present] in OPENING.zh.md follow the English, in the glossary's terms (自我关切, 扩大, 从己方式, 续无外, 容纳, 水平路径, 扩展); 'holding' as an order said as 把自身延续持为对诸进程之次序 / 持守自身延续的次序, keeping as 依靠维持它的东西继续下去. Some courses keep all that others keep and let more form: more future. The law shows this with no premise, and every way of counting each thing at stake as worth something agrees on it; where relations close, a life that holds its own continuation as an order over courses already ranks such a course above.' with Chinese, why (Weighting.widens_iff_every_positive, the self-concern theorems, F1, C named nowhere in the body, its history linked) and an alternative without 'ranks' (ownClosure_unrestricted_iff read on the course). (e) new proposal: 'That takes one step: ... Where relations close, so that every continuation can be affected by every other, whoever counts all that bears on what it depends on already counts everything, and the step is taken; where they run one way, ... there the step is what I offer: to see them, and to count their loss.' and the closing question 'How far our relations close, and how, where they do not, the counting of those who depend on us forms, is our first open question.', with Chinese; why cites Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted, the reading, time, «续无外则同一中心», Downstream.one_way, bounded_rival and message 12's two halves. (b), (d1)–(d3) unchanged. 'If you take any' updated ((a) and (c) go together); the notes list split into sixth and fifth passes.
